subject: Review of PR #18 and PR #19 — Phase 6 ASFDK-C++ umbrella fixes
summary: Reviewed two PR that applied OTOI m_active/m_mode fixes and a Sleepwalker CMakeLists.txt path change. Both PRs merged to main. PR #18 regressed Sleepwalker CMakeLists.txt from VCPKG_ROOT approach to hardcoded /home/joshd path, and its CodeRabbit review flagged: (1) m_active data race (plain mutable bool between safeHonor write and getStatus read), (2) m_mode never updated after safeHonor. Created branch phase-6-review-fixes with: m_active -> std::atomic<bool>, m_mode -> mutable + assigned resolvedEnforcement.mode in safeHonor, restored VCPKG_ROOT in Sleepwalker CMakeLists.txt.
next_action: Create PR from phase-6-review-fixes against main.
